name: Infantry_Mascot
author: Infantry AI
description: Mascot avatars: a selectable avatar style that draws each agent as a small living character (the vendored material-mascot drawing code, MIT) whose pose follows the session state. The role portrait stays the default; disabling this plugin puts it back on its own.

config.title: Mascot avatars
config.applies: Applies to: agent avatars, once the Mascot style is chosen as the avatar style.

fields.label: Motion
fields.description: Static (cheapest, default): one frame per state, no idle loop; the pose changes when the state does. Focus only: the idle loop runs only where the app allows live motion (sidebar, chat header, title bar). Everywhere: every avatar loops, which costs a frame ticker per visible avatar: costly in long chats and big lists. Measured (MASCOT-3, 200 chat rows + 20 sidebar agents, desktop JVM test harness): static about 12 ms per animation frame, focus about 24 ms, everywhere about 24 ms; first composition 120-220 ms for all three.

fields.label: State map
fields.description: SESSION_STATE=Mood pairs separated by semicolons. A state not listed, or a mood the mascot does not know, draws Idle. While compacting a busy session shows Reading; a failed turn shows Alert.

fields.label: Role looks
fields.description: Optional overrides, role=eyes/finish/cat separated by semicolons, e.g. architect=round/chrome/cat. Eyes: classic, big, round, dot, vizor. Finish: flat, chrome, outline. Cat: cat or nocat. Roles not listed get a look from a hash of the role id.
